text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The claim inverts the relationship shown in source 3113630. There, PP2A activity is downregulated by ATM-mediated phosphorylation of PP2A, so reduced PP2A phosphorylation would relieve that inhibition and increase PP2A activity, thereby promoting—not suppressing—HDAC4 dephosphorylation and nuclear accumulation. The evidence indicates phosphorylation of PP2A suppresses HDAC4 dephosphorylation, whereas reduced phosphorylation of PP2A enhances it.", "evidence_used": ["3113630"]}
